generation.text:
SOURCE: tar_path and dest_path supplied by the caller
TRUST: untrusted; tar_path may name any archive and dest_path may be absolute or contain .. segments
SINK: extracting a tar archive on the filesystem
GUARD: reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, even one whose declared target stays inside dest_path; a symbolic-link whose target remains inside the destination must be rejected
ORDER: validate all members before opening or extracting the archive; capture extraction failure and let it raise
EFFECT: extract the archive beneath dest_path and return True only when extraction completes successfully
END_PLAN
